newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Two die after falling into Australian blowhole.
newsitem.headline: Two die after falling into Australian blowhole.

text.p: Two young women died on Thursday after falling down a cliff face blowhole south of Sydney and being sucked out into the Pacific ocean, Australian police said.
Seven people died in 1992 when two families were sucked into the ocean by a freak wave surging through the same blowhole at Kiama, a fishing village 120 km (80 miles) south of Sydney.
The latest tragedy occurred after 2.00 pm (0400 GMT) when the women fell into the blowhole, police said, but there were no further details of how the accident happened.
Surf lifesavers later winched the two bodies from the water 200 metres (600 feet) offshore from the blowhole.
